feature: Buying credits close-out: /credits in one seeded state (never, paused, off)
note: Run once per state, reseeded between runs (see `buying-credits-closeout.json`): `never` draws the offer and Free alone (P2); `paused` draws the pause band in the offers' place (B1); `off` with a pack held draws no offers section (O4). The viewport holds the balance and whatever stands below it (offers, band or history).
